verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents auto attendants that let admins 'design a menu system to direct callers to people or departments.' It supports multi-level auto attendants, TTS or uploaded greetings, and ring groups, so callers can be routed to teams that share a number. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of keypress-to-destination mapping (e.g. 'press 1 for sales'), independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto attendant, and clarity on which subscription tiers include multi-level menus.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams
